title: March 1 Redan youth-subculture gathering calls in Brest, Minsk, Vitebsk and Mogilev
reason: The contemporaneous local report describes youth-subculture meetups and arrests, not a gathering making a demand of Belarusian authorities or state policy. The reported 52 Brest detentions are not an attendance estimate; Minsk has no figures; the Vitebsk clash attribution is unverified; and Mogilev did not form a significant gathering.
notes: Locations remain distinct and their counts are not combined. This screens a non-protest lead; it does not assert that no people gathered in every city. Gomel is not included because this opened article does not report on Gomel.
